entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I need to return something. I bought a helmet a couple of weeks ago, and I just... I can't keep it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number 788-4B21. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I'm just so disappointed this didn't work out.

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the Trail Helmet here, delivered 14 days ago. I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken or anything. It's just... the color. It looked different online, and now it doesn't match my bike at all. The box is unopened, sitting right here. I feel so silly, but I really needed that money for some other things coming up.
I completely understand. Getting the right gear is important. Let me just pull up the return policy for this item. One moment, please.
Okay, thank you. I was just so worried I'd be stuck with it.
Alright, Sarah, I've checked for you. It looks like you're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can absolutely get this return started for you.
Oh, really? Oh, thank goodness. That is such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you so much.

Of course. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process a full refund.
That's perfect. You've been a great help, Alex. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
